args.query: select * from api.limit_balance; select c.id,c.name,c.funding_limit from api.company c; select c.name, sum(k.amount), count(*) from api.contract k join api.application a on a.id=k.application_id join api.company c on c.id=a.company_id group by c.name;
select k.* from api.contract k join api.application a on a.id=k.application_id where a.company_id=20005;
